An '''ingredient''' is an item used to make [[food]]. Matcha Flavoured divides them into intrinsic ingredients, which decide what [[effect]] a dish grants, and base ingredients, which make up the rest of the recipe. Most dishes combine one intrinsic ingredient with a few base ingredients, so learning what each intrinsic ingredient does lets a player predict any dish made from it.<ref>{{Cite video|quote=Have fun experimenting with each ingredient and discovering what properties each food holds.}}</ref>

== Intrinsic ingredients ==
{{Main|Intrinsic}}
Each of these carries one effect, which cooking "awakens". Raw, most only heal a little, and pumpkins, cocoa beans, red mushrooms and the two fungi can't be eaten at all.

[[Golden Apple]]s and [[Golden Carrot|golden carrot]]s are stronger, secret variants of apples and carrots. [[Pufferfish]] carry {{EffectLink|Conduit Power}}.

== Base ingredients ==
These have no intrinsic. They provide healing and structure.
; Grains and doughs
: [[Wheat Grain]] → [[Flour]] → [[Dough]] → [[Bread]] or [[Naan]]. Flour can be stored as a [[Bag of Flour]]. [[Seitan]] is a meat substitute made from dough.
; Sweeteners and spices
: [[Sugar]] (from sugar cane, [[molasses]] or [[Honey Bottle|honey]]) and [[Estus Ash|estus ash]], which serves as the spice in empanadas, cupcakes, curries and toasts.
; Dairy and eggs
: [[Milk Bottle]]s, [[cheese]] and [[egg]]s (any of the three egg colors).
; Fat
: [[Oil]], pressed from sunflowers or cocoa beans.
; Vegetables
: [[Potato]]es, [[Mushroom|brown mushrooms]] (also the pickling agent), [[Nopales|cactus]], ferns, dandelions, blue orchids, bamboo and green dye.
; Meat and fish
: Cooked meat, [[Fish|fish]] and their raw forms, used in pizzas, stroganoff, stocks and nuggets. Meat has no intrinsic.
; Containers
: [[Glass Bottle|Glass bottle]]s for preserves and [[bowl]]s for stews and curries. Both are returned when the food is eaten; a thrown pickle's bottle breaks.

=== Stocks ===
{{Main|Stock}}
The five [[stock]]s are crafted ingredients that are cooked in an [[oven]] into the oven meals.

== Items reused as ingredients ==
Datapacks can't add new items, so most of the pack's ingredients are vanilla items with a new name, model and components. For example, [[flour]] is a renamed enderman spawn egg, [[dough]] a shulker spawn egg and [[Baked Pumpkin|baked pumpkin]] a breeze rod. Spawn eggs are used for ingredients that shouldn't be edible, since spawn eggs can't be eaten.<ref>{{Cite changelog|0.7-alpha|quote=spawn eggs, even without entity data cannot be eaten}}</ref> See [[Renamed items]].

The developer stated that no more ingredients would be added until datapacks can add their own items.<ref>{{Cite changelog|0.7-alpha|quote=I will not add any more food ingredients until Mojang allows us to just add our own items and blocks with datapacks}}</ref>
